terms.shield: share of the zone's perimeter that touches core or corridor — a conservancy that is a park's buffer or a corridor's flank does the plan's work; one in the open does not
terms.pressure_on_core: people × threat P10 within the zone, scaled by min(shared core/corridor edge km / 20, 1) — where the people who will reach the core live; a zone touching no core scores 0
terms.herd_conflict: herd utilisation (all bundles) inside the zone per 1,000 km² — where herders and farmers meet, and where a conservancy committee earns its keep
terms.governance: exp(−(ha / cons_target_ha)²)·(people ≥ cons_min_pop) — a size one committee can run, with enough people to form one
terms.legibility: outer boundary legibility (0–1) — a boundary the members can walk and name
terms.claim: 1930s continuous-occupation share — a customary claim the Land Act 2009 s.66 recognises; strengthens the case
terms.reach: a verified town / OSM town within 25 km — a place a team can be based and supplied
